increment: G7a qualifying ranking and starting order
limits: The starting order is ported and tested but nothing calls it yet: a race still starts with its entries in the order the caller supplies.
racemain.cpp and raceresults.cpp are pinned for provenance and the qualifying excerpt is compiled; the rest of those files is not built.
Championship points and results-file handling around this code are not ported.
The original's qualifying flow, one driver per session cycling the field, is not yet driven by the window, which runs a single solo qualifying session.
The plan assumed qualifying times order the grid directly; the original instead ranks single-driver runs and lets a race read that ranking through its starting order.
scope: Semantic port of the original qualifying ranking and the starting order a race selects, compared against a verbatim excerpt of the newly pinned results code
